title: Drawing UX Polish — Undo, Toolbar, Positions, Window Focus
changes: Right-click cancels incomplete Fibonacci/rectangle previews; Ctrl+Z restores the last drawing add/delete/edit (per symbol, bounded to 60 operations).
Restored OHLC overlay visibility; drawing toolbar has a draggable grip and remembers its last position across devices in existing workspace R2 sync.
All position entry/target/stop price tags appear only for the selected position; target/stop badges now include their percentages and position fills are 50% lighter.
Removed 現價 prefix from price label; removed liquidation upper/lower horizontal guide lines while retaining their price labels.
Drawing manager now edits two global risk amount defaults for new position drawings, shared with existing workspace state sync (old positions unchanged).
Fixed two simultaneous maximized chart windows so taskbar activation brings the selected window forward.
Unchanged: 10-second market indicator re-evaluation, RR / Signal Spotlight, history startup, CoinGlass/Worker, existing per-symbol R2 drawings.
requiredDeploy: GitHub Pages only. Cloudflare Worker and R2 endpoints unchanged.
